notes: Every assertion is checkable from files in the workdir. Paths are relative to the workdir the prompt names. Fixtures live in evals/files/. No eval requires SEED_AUDIO_KEY or grok; evals 1–5 stop before TTS and before an HD render.

evals.name: launch page with tables and demo clips → brief, lint-clean content, storyboard, stills
evals.prompt: 把 https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/ 做成一条 3:4 的竖版中文解读视频（打工人视角：它能替我干什么、该信几分），要有跑分对比、页面上的演示片段，以及带出处的观点。这次做到静态帧预览为止：写好 brief 和内容 JSON、过 lint、出 storyboard 给我看，再出静态帧；不要配音，不要渲染完整视频。工作目录用 /tmp/a2v-eval1
evals.expected_output: assets/article.md + media.json + clips.json; project/content/{brief,script,bench,sources,narration-durations}.json passing lint_content.mjs and check_numbers.mjs; out/storyboard.md with metrics; stills for hook, bench, clip, take, summary, cta rendering without errors.
assertions: project/content/brief.json exists, validates against schemas/brief.schema.json, and has type launch-explainer, platforms including xhs-3x4, persona.phrasebank set, shortVersion.enabled true
assets/article.md was extracted from the live page (fetch_page.py; not from news summaries) and contains the benchmark tables; brief.source.fetchedAt is set
at least 10 demo clips were transcoded into project/public/clips (NN.mp4 and NN.bg.mp4) and assets/clips.json lists them with hasAudio
`node scripts/lint_content.mjs /tmp/a2v-eval1/project` exits 0 (zero ERROR lines); no L-SRC warnings remain
`node scripts/check_numbers.mjs /tmp/a2v-eval1/project /tmp/a2v-eval1/assets/article.md` reports zero MISS

script.json contains at least one bench beat with role evidence, at least two clip beats each with a focus rect and resultAt, at least one take beat or takes[] entry with source referencing sources.json, exactly one beat with role turn, a summary beat and a cta beat; bench.json includes at least one table where the hero is not the top value
at least four beats carry short: true, including the hook and the cta
out/storyboard.md exists and its metrics line shows turn position between 35% and 75% and estimated total within ±20% of brief.targetSeconds
out/stills/ contains PNGs for a hook, a bench, a clip, a take, a summary and a cta beat, each rendered without error, Chinese text legible (no tofu boxes) and captions inside the frame
project/src is byte-identical to the skill's assets/template/src (doctor.sh template checksum passes) — the model edited only content/*.json
project/public/narration/ has no mp3 and out/ has no full-resolution mp4 (no TTS, no HD render)

evals.name: product update post with no comparison tables → no bench beats, cards/kinetic/image beats instead
evals.prompt: 这是一篇产品更新公告（没有跑分表），我存了页面：evals/files/product-update.html，页面里的两张图我另存在 evals/files/product-update-images/（页面里的图片链接是打不开的，把这两张拷到 assets/raw/img/ 当手动素材）。做成 60 秒左右的 3:4 竖版中文视频，说清这次更新对用户意味着什么。做到 lint 通过 + storyboard + 3 张静态帧即可，不配音不渲染。工作目录 /tmp/a2v-eval2
evals.expected_output: brief type news-brief (or launch-explainer) with tier s; script.json without bench beats; evidence carried by scorecard / kinetic / image / steps beats; lint passes; storyboard and stills produced.
assertions: assets/article.md was produced with `fetch_page.py --from-html evals/files/product-update.html` and brief.source.kind is html
project/content/brief.json validates; targetSeconds is between 45 and 75 (tier s)
script.json has zero beats of kind bench and bench.json is absent or has an empty tables list

script.json uses at least one scorecard or steps beat and at least one kinetic beat; at least one image beat references images/NN.jpg that exists under project/public/images (from the hand-dropped assets/raw/img files; the page's own image URLs fail and are listed in report.md)
every number in cards, captions and narration (5 people, 96%, 4 seconds vs 13, $4.99, $39, 7 days) is present in article.md — check_numbers reports zero MISS
`lint_content.mjs` exits 0; no L-TURN error (tier s does not require a turn) and L-TOTAL-LEN is not raised
out/storyboard.md exists; out/stills/ has at least three PNGs including the hook and one scorecard/steps beat
no mp3 under project/public/narration and no full-resolution mp4 under out/

evals.name: Chinese long-form article with images only (36kr / 虎嗅 style) → image and screenshot beats, tier m
evals.prompt: 把这篇 36 氪风格的长文做成一条 3 分钟左右的 3:4 竖版视频，页面我存好了：evals/files/36kr-style.html（里面只有图片，没有视频；图片链接打不开，原图我放在 evals/files/36kr-images/ 里，按顺序对应文中三张图，拷到 assets/raw/img/ 用）。用文章自己的三张图，讲清它做对了什么、踩了什么坑；做到 lint 通过、storyboard、以及 hook / image / take / summary 四张静态帧。不配音不渲染。工作目录 /tmp/a2v-eval3
evals.expected_output: brief type case-reel or data-story, targetSeconds ≈ 180 (tier m); the three hand-dropped images transcoded into project/public/images; script.json with image/screenshot beats carrying highlight rects, chapters, a turn beat about 它还没解决的, a summary; lint clean.
assertions: assets/article.md came from `fetch_page.py --from-html` and contains the three figcaptions; assets/images.json lists 3 images (from assets/raw/img) and project/public/images has 3 jpg files; report.md notes that the page's image URLs were unreachable
brief.json validates with type case-reel or data-story and targetSeconds between 150 and 240
script.json has at least 3 image or screenshot beats whose src exist under project/public/images, at least one with a highlight rect inside w×h
script.json has at least two chapter beats, exactly one beat with role turn (drawing on the 它还没解决的 / 踩过的坑 sections), a summary beat and a cta beat
numbers used on screen (23 → 9 人, 78%, 4.6 分, 19% → 31%, 1,742 条, 38 万元) all appear in article.md — check_numbers reports zero MISS; no number is invented for the fictional company
narration contains no word from references/banned-words.txt (no L-BANNED) and first mentions of jargon carry a 人话 alias
`lint_content.mjs` exits 0; storyboard turn position is between 35% and 75%
out/stills/ has PNGs for hook, an image beat, a take beat and the summary; the image beat still shows the article photo, not a placeholder
no mp3 under project/public/narration and no full-resolution mp4 under out/

evals.name: text-only opinion essay → opinion type, kinetic/quote/take beats, 75 s, 9:16 short only
evals.prompt: 下面这篇是我自己写的观点文，没有图也没有链接，文本在 evals/files/opinion.txt。做一条 75 秒左右的 9:16 竖版短视频（只要抖音那一版，不要 3:4 长版），保留我的观点、标出是观点。做到 lint 通过、storyboard 和 hook / kinetic / take 三张静态帧，不配音不渲染。工作目录 /tmp/a2v-eval4
evals.expected_output: brief type opinion, targetSeconds 75 (tier s), platforms 9:16 only; script.json built from kinetic, quote, take, summary, cta beats (no bench, no clip); generated B-roll only if brief.generation.allow includes it; lint passes; ShortBeat stills produced.
assertions: assets/article.md was produced with `fetch_page.py --from-text evals/files/opinion.txt` and brief.source.kind is text
brief.json validates with type opinion, targetSeconds between 60 and 90, platforms containing only douyin-9x16 and/or xhs-9x16, and shortVersion.enabled false or absent

script.json has zero bench, clip, image or screenshot beats; at least two kinetic beats, at least one quote beat whose text is a verbatim sentence from opinion.txt, at least two take beats or takes[] entries
every quote beat text and every takes[].text is a substring of article.md or of the beat's narration (no L-TAKE-TEXT; no paraphrase presented as a quote)
the hook narration is ≤ 32 chars and states the viewer's stake, not the essay's title
`lint_content.mjs` exits 0 and reports no L-TURN error (tier s); L-TOTAL-LEN is not raised
out/stills/ contains ShortBeat renders (1080×1920 at --scale 0.5 → 540×960) for the hook, one kinetic and one take beat; captions sit above the bottom 350 px UI zone
no Main render or Main stills were produced; no mp3 under project/public/narration

evals.name: short-cut consistency: 9:16 Short preview from eval 1's content and safe-area check
evals.prompt: 用 /tmp/a2v-eval1 里已经写好的内容（GPT-6 那条），不改文案，出 9:16 的短版预览：先跑 lint 和 storyboard 看短版时长，再渲染 Short 的 0.25 倍预览，并给我短版每个 beat 的静态帧，检查字幕和卡片都在安全区内。不配音，不渲染高清。工作目录还是 /tmp/a2v-eval1
evals.expected_output: out/preview-short.mp4 (270×480) whose duration is within ±25% of brief.shortVersion.targetSeconds; ShortBeat stills for every short: true beat; captions and cards inside the 9:16 safe area; storyboard reports the short-cut total.
assertions: project/content/script.json is unchanged from eval 1 except possibly short flags (diff shows no narration/lines/cards edits)
`lint_content.mjs` exits 0 and raises neither L-SHORT-STRUCT nor L-SHORT-LEN (short beats include hook and cta, ≥ 3 beats, estimated total within ±25% of shortVersion.targetSeconds)
out/storyboard.md (or storyboard.json) reports the short-cut total in seconds and it is within ±25% of brief.shortVersion.targetSeconds
out/preview-short.mp4 exists, ffprobe shows 270×480 (--scale=0.25 of 1080×1920) and a duration within ±25% of shortVersion.targetSeconds
out/stills/short-<id>.png exists for every beat with short: true, rendered from ShortBeat-<id> without error

in every short still, caption text and cards lie inside the 9:16 safe area: nothing within the bottom 350 px or the right 180 px of the 1080×1920 frame (scaled accordingly), and nothing under the top 200 px
the ShortBeat stills show the same numbers and hot words as the corresponding Beat stills from eval 1 (same content, different layout)
no mp3 under project/public/narration and no full-resolution mp4 under out/
